notablePrerequisites: You have had five nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler
Activate Crystalline Crawler four times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{W}.
